titulos.cg_beso_nikki_cerca: A taste of tequila and bad decisions
titulos.cg_rikka_secreto: Too Much Faith in the Steam

info_imagenes.cg_jair_carga_cami: Jair's first physical contact with a woman in months. She's pointing a gun at him. He's going to call it a date.
info_imagenes.cg_jair_carga_cami_espalda: Estimated weight: forty-something kilos of pilot and three hundred of contempt. Jair hasn't carried this much since he moved out and learned nobody would help with the washing machine.
info_imagenes.cg_caida_multiverso: Free fall between dimensions at terminal velocity. According to Jair, still less stressful than a Monday meeting with the camera on.
info_imagenes.cg_jair_carga_cami_bosque: In his arms again. Nobody covers the mileage. Just like his job, but with a better view and the same wrecked back.
info_imagenes.cg_beso_nikki_cerca: Eight years of «we're just friends» summed up in one second. Tomorrow nobody will talk about it. That was always the plan.
info_imagenes.cg_beso_nikki: The hard part comes later: waking up, opening the chat and pretending nothing happened. They both have years of practice.
info_imagenes.cg_rikka_nalgada: Five hundred years as a priestess, a borrowed suit and one second of badly managed trust. Rikka still hasn't decided if it was an insult or a declaration of war. Cami already decided it was funny.
info_imagenes.cg_rikka_secreto: Secret image: only for those who reached 100% and then kept poking the badges. Rikka wants to know who did it. We recommend not telling her.
info_imagenes.cg_nikki_cachetadas: Eight years of friendship, one hand where it should not have been and a barrage of slaps that did not stop in time. Nikki still does not understand how anyone dies from that. Neither does Jair, but he no longer gets a say.

jair/base.info: Jair in his natural state: no full paycheck, no sleep and no expectations. Thirty years in beta and nobody has filed the bug.

jair/cansado1.info: The face of someone who still has to answer three «urgent» emails from a client who doesn't read. The sweat is real; the air conditioning isn't.

jair/cansado2.info: He's spent fifteen minutes explaining why the bug isn't his. The bug is his.

jair/molesto.info: His most aggressive version: crossing his arms and coming up with the perfect comeback three hours later, in the shower.

jair/triste1.info: He looks at his savings account the way other people look at photos of their ex. He never says how much. He never spends it. It's never enough.

jair/sabelotodo.info: The pose of someone who just explained something nobody asked about. Works better on monsters than on people.

jair/verguenza1.info: He blushes if a woman talks to him, if she doesn't, and if she exists nearby. He scratches his neck because he read it looks casual. It doesn't.

jair/atontado_cansado.nombre: In love and behind on sleep
jair/atontado_cansado.info: The smile of someone who got a «good morning in advance» and has read it eleven times. Going for twelve.

jair/asustado1.info: His reaction to monsters, soldiers, armed women and the phrase «got a minute?». Same face for all of them.

jair/orgulloso.info: The one time something worked out for him. Enjoy it: there won't be another sprite like this for a long time.

nikki/trabajo_base.info: Twelve hours smiling at Sweet Chill. The name tag is there so customers can call her without looking at her face.

nikki/trabajo_cansada.info: Hour eleven of the shift. The smile is still on; the person left a while ago.

nikki/trabajo_puchero.info: Customers get the smile; Jair gets the pout. It's a kind of trust, or something that looks a lot like it.

nikki/trabajo_orgullosa.info: She sells ice cream the way you'd sell relief: cold, sweet and gone before you notice.

nikki/base.info: No uniform and no mandatory smile. This is Nikki when nobody pays her to be nice.

nikki/tierna1.info: The face Jair saves for bad nights. It doesn't show up often. That's why he mistakes it for love.

nikki/celosa1.info: She tells him to find someone and then looks at him like this. Eight years of contradictory instructions and no manual.

nikki/celosa2.info: She's working out who the girl is that he hasn't mentioned. Spoiler: there isn't one. That bothers her too.

nikki/enojada.info: The answer Jair gets when he asks the wrong question. Meaning: any question.

nikki/muyenojada1.info: Recommended: don't talk, don't breathe loudly and, above all, don't mention the taxi.

nikki/fria.info: So cold she could be sold at her own shop. No sprinkles, no cone, no refunds.

nikki/wtf.info: What her face does when Jair talks about his job with enthusiasm. It takes a while to load.

nikki/celosaebria.nombre: What doesn't get said by day
nikki/celosaebria.info: Sober, she doesn't ask. At this hour she does. Tomorrow neither of them will mention it out loud: that's the deal.

nikki/ebria1.info: It's never just one. The joke stops being funny when the bill comes, and the bill always comes.

nikki/ebria2.info: At this hour she asks for what she never asks for by day: that he stays. He always stays. Neither of them learns.

nikki/triste1.info: The face she makes when the bar goes quiet and there's no noise left to cover anything.

nikki/llorando1.info: She cries like someone who's held it in for months and picked the worst moment to stop. Or the only one.

nikki/llorando2.info: There's no right answer to this. Jair knows it, and he still looks for one in the documentation.

cami/base.info: Orphan, rebel, no ship and a broken ankle. Still the most stable person in this story.

cami/apuntando.info: This is how Cami says hello. If you're still alive after this sprite, she likes you.

cami/molesta2.info: The face of someone who just found out her rescuer can't shoot, fight or walk in a straight line.

cami/dudosa1.nombre: Lie detector with a broken ankle
cami/dudosa1.info: She already knows Jair is lying. She's just deciding whether it's worth the effort to say so.

cami/burlona.info: When she smiles like this, someone is about to be humiliated. Usually Jair. Almost always Jair. Fine, always.

cami/fria.info: Minus two hundred seventy degrees of affection. Ideal for preserving other people's pride for years.

cami/cansada.info: Everything hurts, but what hurts most is having to let him carry her.

cami/molesta1.info: Her default state every time Jair opens his mouth.

cami/impactada.info: Something caught her off guard, which is very rare. Jair probably did something useful.

cami/molesta3.info: It's not the gun that's scary. It's that she hasn't drawn it yet.

cami/sorprendida.info: An emotion that wasn't in her manual. You can tell she doesn't know where to put it.

cami/triste.info: She remembers her fleet, her planet and a drawing on a door. Some memories feel strangely heavy, as if they were borrowed.

cami/wtf.info: The exact face she makes when Jair says this world is his dream. She doesn't believe him yet. Yet.

cami/sonrojada1.info: A blush nobody asked for. If you ask, she denies it. If you insist, she shoots you.

rikka/base.info: Over five hundred years guarding a bridge and nobody has ever paid her. Jair feels he's finally found his people.

rikka/celosa.info: She waited centuries for someone to fall from the sky. Someone did, carrying someone else. Millennial bad luck.

rikka/orgullosa.info: Leftover pride from an ancient family. It lasts exactly until someone mentions a price.

rikka/preocupada.info: Her biggest fear isn't monsters: it's being charged. She asks the price of air, just in case.

rikka/sorprendida.info: A stranger just guessed she's over five hundred years old. No woman is ready for that, not even an immortal one.

soldado_enmascarado/base.info: Patrols in a loop, never improvises and never asks for a raise. The ideal employee according to Jair's management.

capitan_enmascarado/base.info: They didn't even give him a name. He has a rifle, a red visor and less identity than Jair, which is saying something.

monstruo_sombras/base.info: It couldn't cross gaps. They patched it. That's how updates work: they fix exactly the thing that was saving you.

monstruo_sombras/armored.info: Same shadow, now with rocks. It still freezes, because nobody wrote it any rules for winter.

vendedor/base.info: He gives sweets to the guardian's friends. In any other kingdom that's called a bribe; here, hospitality.

mike/base.info: His sword is longer than he is. So is his confidence.

mike/entusiasmado.info: He thinks Jair fell from the sky. Technically he's right, and that's the worrying part.

mike/molesto.info: He didn't believe Jair was a god. Not even kids buy his pitch.

mike/asustado.info: First the birds go quiet, then the merchants, then the kids. Mike knows the order.

nora/base.info: She brought flowers. Well, they were flowers. Mike fell on them.

nora/sorprendida.info: "Is he your boyfriend?" So small and already a master at ruining a guardian's afternoon.

nora/sonrojada.info: She saw Rikka stutter. She needs no further evidence.

nora/asustada.info: She doesn't understand what's happening, but she understands the grown-ups are scared. That's enough.

rikka/tierna.info: For a second she stops being the bridge guardian and remembers how to be sweet. It didn't last. It never does.

rikka/sonrojada.info: They asked her if Jair was her boyfriend. Five hundred years of discipline, defeated by a little girl with flowers.

rikka/enojada.info: Take a good look: it's the last face many saw when they tried to cross without permission.

rikka/triste.info: Someone wrote her years ago and left her half done. She's still waiting for the ending.

guardia_primavera/base.info: Green armor, emblem on the chest and zero patience for beings from other dimensions. A bit taller than Jair; much, much better armed.

rikka/espada2.info: Rikka asks for permission before cutting you. It's a Spring courtesy.

cami/toalla_base.info: Cami relaxes the way she does everything: with a weapon less than a meter away.

cami/toalla_molesta.info: Jair wasn't looking. Cami doesn't believe him. Cami is right.

cami/toalla_orgullosa.info: She knows exactly the effect she has. She uses it to win arguments.

rikka/toalla_base.info: Her first time sharing the hot springs with someone from another dimension. It won't be the last thing she regrets.

rikka/toalla_demasiado_avergonzada.info: Her face went from pink to red, and from red to a color Spring hasn't named yet.

rikka/toalla_llorando.info: Her sacred garments were stolen. Enchanted: they resist cold, heat and, apparently, nobody with quick hands.

rikka/toalla_llorando_mucho.info: She cried over the garments. And over everything else. Nobody cries like that over clothes.

rikka/traje_base.info: Cami's red suit. It fits her perfectly. That's the problem.

rikka/traje_avergonzda.info: A Spring priestess in a skin-tight suit. The kingdom would call it heresy. Jair wouldn't.

rikka/traje_avergonzada_ropa.info: She tries to cover up with her hands. She's short on hands.

rikka/traje_avergonzada_asustada.info: She noticed she was being looked at. She noticed too late.

rikka/traje_avergonzada_asustada_espalda.info: Turning around seemed like a good idea. It wasn't.

rikka/traje_muy_humillada_avergonzada.info: She says nobody had ever touched her so vulgarly. Cami doesn't apologize.

nail/base.info: Orange hair, humble clothes and quick hands. She steals for her siblings and her mother. A borrowed suit pays the bill.

cami/armored_base.info: The AI gave her metal armor mid-fight. No tutorial, no terms and conditions.

cami/armored_seria.info: Faster, stronger and just as unpleasant. The update didn't touch her personality.

cami/armored_furiosa.info: Armored lasts a while and needs recharging. Her bad mood doesn't.

cami/armored_bersek_medio.info: The blue suit asked for an update and the AI installed heavy artillery. Now the suit has more cannons than pockets and more ammo than patience. And Cami's patience was already at zero.

rikka/desbloqueable_espalda.info: Behind the rock, convinced nobody can see her. Convinced.

rikka/desbloqueable_frente.info: The wind took the steam away right on time. For the wind.

rikka/desbloqueable_frente_asustada.info: Ten pokes. That is the patience limit of a five-hundred-year-old priestess.

rikka/desbloqueable_espalda_asustada.info: It was heard in all four kingdoms. And in your house.

rikka/desbloqueable_espalda_asustada2.info: She looks at the bushes. She should be looking at the screen.

rikka/desbloqueable_espalda_asustada_ult.info: The exact second before the scream. You can still let go of the mouse.

rikka/desbloqueable_vistiendose.info: No buttons, no laces, no dignity.

rikka/desbloqueable_vistiendose_muy_aver.info: Cami picked it on purpose. Rikka is sure of it.

oficina_dia.info: Where Jair trades hours of his life for a paycheck that arrives late. The AC has been under maintenance for three months; his dignity, longer.

calle_noche.info: The city has no name, but it has heat. Here you walk fast and think slow.

dulce_frio_fachada.info: The ice cream shop where Nikki works. Twenty-four flavors and a shift that never ends.

bar_noche.info: Cheap tequila, loud music and decisions you pay off in installments.

calle_noche_taxi.info: Where nights that shouldn't end like this say goodbye. Or that shouldn't have started at all.

departamento_noche.info: One room, one bathroom and a kitchen that's also a hallway. The fan is Jair's most stable relationship.

departamento_poster.info: A generic-faced boy saving a world that isn't his. Jair looks at it every night. Neither of them learns.

nebulosa_magenta.info: The first thing Jair sees when he opens his eyes inside the game. Pretty, huge and no signal.

castillo_flotante_ruinas.info: White stone, cold and smooth like a bank floor. Just as welcoming.

pasillo_castillo.info: Floating blocks that don't fall, but don't inspire confidence either. Like the company Jair works for.

pasillo_giratorio.info: The path doesn't turn: the whole corridor does. Architecture by someone who hated visitors.

puente_torres.info: A chunk is missing in the middle. The jump is optional; the fall isn't.

refugio_capsula.info: A white metal capsule set into the tower. The closest thing to an apartment Jair can afford.

hangar.info: Ships, soldiers in black and the budget that never reaches the Resistance.

pozo_central.info: A spiral staircase around a shaft of blue light. Jair counted the steps. He lost count. And the will.

calabozo.info: A cot, a light that never turns off and nothing else. Better ventilated than Jair's apartment.

nucleo_grieta.info: A room the size of a stadium. The key activated here for the first time. There's no undo button.

desierto_cristal.info: A scrap of ground floating in nothing, between one dimension and the next. Three meters of island and zero emergency exits.

bosque_ancestral.info: The entrance to the seasons dimension. They landed on grass: for the first time in the game, something soft caught them.

claro_cuatro_estaciones.info: On the border between Winter and Spring, the four kingdoms are so close that all four seasons fit in a single clearing. Jair comes from a city with a single season: "it's hot".

bosque_invierno.info: A frozen stream and ice that creaks before it breaks. Like Jair.

puente_rojo.info: The bridge Rikka has guarded for so long she no longer remembers. Nobody crosses without permission. Jair crossed.

sendero_primavera.info: The road to the citadel, between cherry trees in bloom. Here Rikka stares at a stream with great concentration.

batalla/jair.info: Level 5, one shirt and the belief that punches thrown with eyes closed still count. Statistically, sometimes they do.

batalla/cami.info: Level 15 and a short-range blaster. Hits hard, rests a turn and lets nobody flee: fleeing is for cowards and she does not fight alone.

batalla/rikka.info: Five hundred years of katana summed up in sixteen bits. The flower in her hair is not decorative: it is a warning.

batalla/soldado.info: Red visor, black armor and no opinions of his own. Ask him about overtime and he freezes, processing.

batalla/nikki.info: Level 20, a black t-shirt and two hands that never learned to hit softly. The kiss confuses; the slaps don't: those are perfectly clear.

batalla/sombra.info: Walking ink. It throws purple crescents, sinks into the floor and comes out under whoever least expects it. It doesn't die: it retreats.

batalla/capitan.info: Red bursts, three to five at a time, and a cannon that charges until it turns white. When he gets nervous, he waves it around. That's when to worry.

lineas: Again?! Who gave you permission to touch me? I was the priestess of Spring for five hundred years, you know.
In my kingdom, whoever touched a priestess got exiled. Here they get an achievement.
Oh, of course. The gallery. The only place in the multiverse where nobody defends me.
If Jair touched me like that, I would faint. You are not Jair. You are a click.
First the hot springs, then the spank, now you. This is not a story anymore: it is a joke with me inside it.
I asked the author whether my character had an arc. The answer was yes: "the one on her back".
Five hundred years of noble lineage, only to end up as the one who gets poked in the extras menu.
Does this cost anything? Will they charge me? They always charge me.
Cami got a blaster. I got emblems. Guess who gets poked.
I do not even scream anymore. Screaming is what the script expects. I will not give it the pleasure.
I am warning you: the flower in my hair is not decorative. Neither is the katana.
Condemned for all eternity to someone clicking where they should not. That is how Spring ends.
Keep going and I will ask the steam to come back. The steam respects me.
I know you are going to do it again. I know. I have accepted it. Almost.
